Baskin Financial Services Continues to Hold Stake in Bank Of Nova Scotia (BNS); Jd Com (JD) Shareholder Iconiq Capital Has Decreased Its Holding by $764,609 
April 16, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers 
Iconiq Capital Llc decreased its stake in Jd Com Inc (JD) by 6.65% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Iconiq Capital Llc sold 18,649 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.51% with the market. The hedge fund held 261,812 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $10.85 million, down from 280,461 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Iconiq Capital Llc who had been investing in Jd Com Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $57.09B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.97% or $0.8 during the last trading session, reaching $39.8. About 8.11M shares traded. JD.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:JD) has risen 29.73% since April 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 18.18% the S&P500. 
Baskin Financial Services Inc increased its stake in Bank Of Nova Scotia (BNS) by 1.86% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Baskin Financial Services Inc bought 4,829 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.86% with the market. The institutional investor held 263,809 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $17.10M, up from 258,980 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Baskin Financial Services Inc who had been investing in Bank Of Nova Scotia for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $69.94 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.62% or $0.38 during the last trading session, reaching $60.66. About 479,239 shares traded. The Bank of Nova Scotia (NYSE:BNS) has risen 3.96% since April 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 7.59% the S&P500. 
Analysts await JD.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:JD) to report earnings on May, 14. They expect $0.03 EPS, down 62.50% or $0.05 from last year’s $0.08 per share. JD’s profit will be $43.03 million for 331.67 P/E if the $0.03 EPS becomes a reality. After $-0.10 actual EPS reported by JD.com, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -130.00% EPS growth. 
Iconiq Capital Llc, which manages about $7.58 billion and $969.52 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Vanguard Index Fds (VTI) by 11,006 shares to 114,905 shares, valued at $15.77 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Ishares Tr (ACWI) by 43,219 shares in the quarter, for a total of 2.42 million shares, and has risen its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL). 
Among 22 analysts covering JD.com ( NASDAQ:JD ), 17 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 5 Hold. Therefore 77% are positive. JD.com had 48 analyst reports since August 4, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Nomura upgraded it to “Buy” rating and $35 target in Friday, January 22 report. The stock of JD.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:JD) has “Outperform” rating given on Tuesday, August 11 by Macquarie Research. Bernstein initiated the stock with “Underperform” rating in Wednesday, January 11 report. The rating was maintained by Jefferies with “Buy” on Thursday, August 11. The firm has “Market Perform” rating given on Tuesday, May 9 by Bernstein. The rating was initiated by TH Capital on Tuesday, August 4 with “Buy”. The stock of JD.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:JD) has “Buy” rating given on Tuesday, October 3 by Jefferies. The company was initiated on Thursday, August 6 by TH Capital. Cowen & Co maintained JD.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:JD) rating on Wednesday, August 16. Cowen & Co has “Hold” rating and $40.0 target. The firm earned “Neutral” rating on Wednesday, August 31 by JP Morgan. 
Among 9 analysts covering The Bank Of Nova Scotia ( NYSE:BNS ), 6 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 3 Hold. Therefore 67% are positive. The Bank Of Nova Scotia had 17 analyst reports since August 4, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Overweight” rating given on Tuesday, May 23 by Barclays Capital. The company was maintained on Wednesday, May 31 by RBC Capital Markets. The stock of The Bank of Nova Scotia (NYSE:BNS) earned “Buy” rating by Dundee Securities on Wednesday, September 21. The stock of The Bank of Nova Scotia (NYSE:BNS) earned “Neutral” rating by Macquarie Research on Thursday, June 9. The stock of The Bank of Nova Scotia (NYSE:BNS) has “Outperform” rating given on Wednesday, December 2 by RBC Capital Markets. The company was maintained on Tuesday, August 29 by Canaccord Genuity. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Friday, August 28 by Canaccord Genuity. RBC Capital Markets maintained the stock with “Outperform” rating in Monday, August 31 report.
